speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your condition, can you tell me how long you have been experiencing the cough and shortness of breath, and does the cough produce any phlegm?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had the cough for about eight weeks now, and it started dry but has turned productive with clear phlegm. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Heart Failure with Reduced Ejection Fraction (HFrEF) presenting with chronic cough and dyspnea. Given the cardiologist's confirmation and your history of fatigue, we will proceed with optimizing your heart failure management rather than investigating new pulmonary pathology.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Acute exacerbation of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
